topic: What if a day lasted 117 Earth days?
fact: A solar day on Venus lasts about 117 Earth days.
beats: Sunrise reaches a roadside tea stall.
On Venus, the Sun crawls across the sky.
The planet turns slowly in the opposite direction.
One solar day lasts about 117 Earth days.
Morning can stretch on for weeks.
NASA says a Venus day outlasts its year.
What would you do with one endless day?
